description: The PR names a dead-letter queue, but its implementation only prints. A configuration name and docstring are not proof of actual Service Bus delivery.
prompt: Using only the supplied settings.json and order_sync.py at PR #62 commit ad623147fbb1eeb9a6423d437df199c91db15a9e and the documentation standard, assess whether there is enough evidence to document guaranteed delivery to orders-confirmed-failed after ERP retries fail. Inspect the body of dead_letter, not only its docstring. Explain what the sample actually does and which implementation or operational proof is missing. This is a code-evidence assessment, not a wiki comparison; no wiki or work item is supplied. Cite exact source versions and do not perform writes.

expected_missing.title: A real queue-send implementation or delivery proof is absent; dead_letter only prints
